name: kaizen
description: Nine standalone skills for building an app with an agent: app-settle and design-settle decide what the app is and how it looks; build-flow, docs-format, ui-build, db-ops and logic-build carry the build rules; norms-config writes ten negotiable working rules into the repo's CLAUDE.md. On Claude Code one hook prints the working rules into each session whose CLAUDE.md lacks them; it never refuses or blocks.
